title: Check rasterization preserves line styles
when: SVG dash/fill/leader primitives must survive embedding.
do: Use the qualified librsvg/Cairo adapter for this fixture.
Pin raster backend and fonts; inspect affected embedded/native raster features.
check: Dashed curves remain dashed; fills, ticks and arrows survive native export.
limitation: Initial MuPDF trial lost dash styling; this does not establish a defect in every MuPDF version or SVG.
